newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bangkok Bank closes US$150 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok Bank closes US$150 mln FRCD.

text.p: Bangkok Bank's US$150 million floating rate certificate of deposit has been allotted, arranger HSBC Markets said.
They said the facility has a final maturity of seven years with a put option in year five.
The issue was priced at par to float at 18.75 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 24 basis points.
Arranger and lead manager HSBC Markets committed US$59 million.
Co-arranger and lead managers with US$12 million each are IBJ Asia, Merrill Lynch International, JP Morgan Securities Asia, Sakura Finance Asia and Tokai Asia.
Co-lead managers are Yokohama Asia, with US$10 million, and Asahi Finance Hong Kong, Banca Nazionale del Lavoro SpA Singapore and PT Bank Negara Indonesia, with US$5 million each.
Senior managers, with US$3 million each, are DIE ERSTE osterreichische Spar-Casse-Bank AG and Morgan Stanley Asia.
